limit: Routing/ranking overhead and hand-labelled synthetic smoke checks only. Three answering-model descriptors are synthetic; no answering CLI starts. No representative accuracy, full-answer speedup, token saving or forced model unloading is measured. First request may use a resident model. Warmup resets an initial failure cooldown only for this benchmark; later errors retain runtime fallback behaviour.
